description: Returns the rules and a reference JavaScript pattern for making an HTML presentation interactive with Sparka: Start/End buttons and their labels, a lobby with the QR code, PIN and join URL that can be opened from any slide, switching the live question when slides change, Reveal, live answer counts, countdowns that stop when a question closes, animated results, leaderboard and podium slides, reconnecting, and graceful offline behavior. The reference code's look can be adapted to the deck; its behavior is what makes a deck work with Sparka. Sparka ships no script library — the deck's own code is the integration. No account key needed.
name: sparka_deck_guide
title: Get the deck guide
